title: Evidence telemetry milestones and on-call escalation playbook for SOC2/ISO SSO & auditlog rollout
creator: Mariana Gomez
description: Goal: Create a milestone plan and runbook that ties automated telemetry collection (SSO/SAML flows + audit logs) to compliance evidence checkpoints for SOC2 and ISO audits, and define on-call escalation and escape-hatch procedures for evidence gaps during cutovers. Scope includes milestone definitions, evidence snapshot windows, retention verification, cross-region timestamp validation, and operator playbooks for emergency rollbacks or manual evidence stitching. Excludes infra provisioning for Dedicated clusters (handled by ENG).
acceptance_criteria: Milestone map with dates, owners, and required artifacts for each compliance checkpoint (e.g., SSO enablement, audit-log retention proof, log integrity verification).
Automated evidence snapshot job defined and scheduled that produces signed artifacts for a sample customer org and stores manifest in evidence-bucket with immutable retention tags.
On-call escalation playbook published that includes alert triggers, primary/secondary rotations, runbook steps, and rollback criteria for evidence regressions.
End-to-end smoke test harness that validates SSO login events appear in audit logs with consistent timestamps across regions and generates a pass/fail report.
Stakeholder sign-off from Security (SOC owner), Legal, and two customer-facing PMs prior to milestone gating.
progress_updates: 2026-03-01: Kickoff with Security and Infra. Mapped initial evidence artifacts required by SOC2 and ISO auditors.
2026-03-04: Security requested immutable retention tags and HMAC-signed manifests for snapshot artifacts; added to acceptance criteria.
2026-03-06: Infra (ENG) flagged dependency on cross-region log-forwarding change (ENG-2639). Added dependency and adjusted timeline.
2026-03-09: Draft on-call escalation flow created; proposed alert thresholds for missing evidence windows and drift detection.
2026-03-12: PM review with Legal completed; clarified PII redaction constraints for shared evidence artifacts and updated runbook notes.
next_steps: Finalize milestone timetable with Security and Customer Success by 2026-03-18.
ENG to estimate implementation work for snapshot job and cross-region validation by 2026-03-22.
Create initial smoke test harness prototype and run against staging to validate timestamp drift by 2026-04-02.
Circulate on-call playbook for review in Cycle 2026-W11 and schedule tabletop run with SRE and Support.
risks: Cross-region log forwarding latency could cause intermittent evidence gaps; may need buffering and reingestion strategy.
Legal constraints on PII may require aggressive redaction that complicates automated signing of artifacts.
Dependency on ENG-2639 (log-forwarding) delays the snapshot job and pushes gating to later cycles.
Customer-facing audits may request proofs in formats we don't currently generate; requires mapping to auditor expectations early.
